headline: Ingersoll Rand to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference
summary: DAVIDSON, N.C., July 28, 2026--Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE: IR), a global provider of mission-critical flow creation and life science and industrial solutions, announced that Vik Kini, chief financial officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Deutsche Bank Chicago Industrials Summit on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 11 a.m. Central Time.
